realistic.label: realistic
realistic.goal: 写实版材质，风格不变（暗沉、色调深、纹理突出）
realistic.anchor: Image 1 is the game frame to convert; Image 2 is a style reference only. Convert Image 1 into realistic materials while keeping the style unchanged, taking the materials, lighting, color grading, darkness and texture detail from Image 2. Take nothing else from Image 2: none of its objects, layout, UI, icons or text. Keep the composition, camera angle, and the position, shape, size, count and color relationships of every object in Image 1 exactly the same; only replace the cartoon materials of objects already in Image 1 with real-world realistic materials (the list below only describes materials, do not add any objects because of it): {materials}. {look} Keep on-screen UI numbers, icons and buttons of Image 1 exactly as they are. {remove}Do not add any new text, captions, watermarks or logos. Keep the image clean and sharp, with no heavy noise and no broken or fragmented artifacts. {extra}
realistic.keyframe: Image 1 is the game frame to convert; Image 2 is the already converted realistic first frame of the same video. Following the style of Image 2, convert Image 1 into realistic materials while keeping the style unchanged. Keep the composition, camera angle, and the position, shape and count of every object in Image 1 exactly the same; match the materials, lighting, color grading, darkness and ground of Image 2. Realistic materials for objects already in the frame (the list below only describes materials, do not add any objects because of it): {materials}. {look} Keep on-screen UI numbers, icons and buttons exactly as they are. {remove}Do not add any new text, captions, watermarks or logos. No heavy noise and no broken or fragmented artifacts. {extra}
realistic.video: Edit the video: change the materials of every object in the video to realistic materials while keeping the style unchanged. The realistic look of the first frame follows Image 1, and the materials, lighting, color grading and darkness of the whole video stay consistent with Image 1. Keep the camera motion, composition, character actions, the position, size and count of objects, and the timing exactly the same as the original video; do not add any objects. Only replace the materials of objects already in the frame (the list below only describes materials, do not add any objects because of it): {materials}. {look} Keep on-screen UI numbers, icons and buttons exactly as they are. {remove}Do not add any new text, captions, watermarks or logos. No heavy noise and no broken or fragmented artifacts, no flicker, and keep materials consistent from frame to frame. {extra}
realistic.default_materials: realistic ground, water, ice and snow, wood, stone, metal, plants, cloth and character clothing
realistic.look: Overall look: dark and moody, low-key exposure, deep rich tones, deep cold blue water with white foam, cold overcast light with soft deep shadows, strong pronounced surface textures (wood grain, bark, wet mud, packed dirty snow, stone, rope fibres, fabric weave, fish scales), crisp fine detail, slightly gritty but clean. Never bright, pastel, glossy or cartoonish.

remove: Remove the {items} from the frame and fill the area naturally with the surrounding scene, leaving no trace; remove only these elements and keep all other text, numbers, signs and UI in the frame unchanged.
